description: Add data-grounded tables and figures to an existing Chinese/English research report or paper in DOCX, keeping every number traceable to the source text. Use when the user uploads a .docx report and asks to 补充图表 / 插入表格 / 配图 / 数据可视化 / "看看哪里可以加图表", or asks to turn passages with statistics into 三线表 or matplotlib charts. Covers planning which passages deserve exhibits, designing three-line tables, drawing publication-style charts with exact values from the text, inserting captions/notes/in-text references, and verifying pagination. Do NOT use for rewriting text or for generating illustrative photos (that is an image-generation task).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent gather relevant evidence before concluding?
Did the final report trace conclusions back to observable evidence?
